reviews.text: Rivera & Sons Roofers LLC did an excellent job replacing the roof, soffits, fascia, and gutters on my house, as well as my parents' and uncle's homes. We got quotes from a few other roofing companies, but their price was the best, and the quality of their work really stood out. Their team showed a lot of experience—everything was handled professionally from start to finish. After the job was completed, we noticed a couple of minor things that needed a little attention, and Brayden and the crew came back quickly to take care of them. I’m very happy with the service, the fair price, and how great everything looks. If you need any roofing work done, I highly recommend reaching out.
reviews.author: Anita Calderon

reviews.text: Tracy did an excellent job replacing our roof and installing a new attic fan for our home in Carrollton. The price was fair and the quality of the roofing work really stood out. Everything went smoothly—from the dumpster arriving early in the morning, to Brayden and the crew starting work right away. Even though several sheets of plywood needed replacement, the entire project was finished in just one day. One of the gutters was accidentally damaged during the work, but Tracy let us know about it before we even noticed and made sure it was replaced the very next day. We are extremely happy with our new roof and highly recommend their roofing services to anyone in Carrollton.
reviews.author: Katie Castaneda

reviews.text: If you’re looking for a reliable roofing company in Carrollton, hire Rivera & Sons Roofers LLC. They’re trustworthy, honest, and their workmanship is excellent. When you take on a major roofing project, it’s important to know the crew will do the job right and stand behind their work. That’s exactly what you get here. We started searching for roofers last winter and eventually chose this team to handle our roof, gutters, and dormers over the summer. Their pricing was fair—right in the middle compared to the other quotes we received. After months of research, what really convinced us was their clear communication and integrity. Every promise they made was included in our contract, which shows how straightforward and honest they are. A lot of other companies tried high-pressure sales tactics, but didn’t put anything in writing. With this crew, everything was upfront and transparent. They have years of experience, and Brayden and the team were fantastic—hardworking, detail-oriented, and finished everything on time. Our new roof and dormers look beautiful, and they added special details to the dormers that match the original farmhouse style perfectly. The care and attention to detail were impressive, and we’re extremely happy with the results. If you value quality craftsmanship and want a roofer you can trust in Carrollton, this is the company to call.
reviews.author: Richard Welch

reviews.text: Rivera & Sons Roofers LLC is an outstanding roofing company with a fantastic way of handling everything from the first estimate to the final inspection. We were extremely pleased with the whole process of our roof repair. The team finished our project even sooner than expected, working hard and paying attention to every detail. They really stand by their workmanship, and if we ever need any roofing help in Carrollton again, we will definitely reach out to them. I highly recommend their services for any roofing job—you won’t be disappointed. They truly are the best in the business!
reviews.author: Tucker17 D

reviews.text: If you’re looking for a roofer, here’s what I experienced with Rivera & Sons Roofers LLC during my residential shingle reroof. The company offered fair, competitive pricing and responded quickly when I asked for an estimate. I was impressed with the personal attention from Brayden, who kept me updated every step of the way. When it was time to sign the contract, they asked for a reasonable down payment. Their communication about the schedule was excellent, so I always knew what to expect. First, they delivered the underlayment rolls right onto the roof, followed by a dumpster that arrived ahead of the job start. They let me know when this would happen, and explained that the dumpster would be placed near the eaves for the crew to easily toss old materials straight down—usually this meant moving cars out of the driveway. On the first workday, the crew arrived bright and early to start removing the old shingles. The team worked hard all day, taking care to replace any damaged roof boards, install the new underlayment, and begin putting on new shingles. They only paused for the building inspector to check the quality and progress. The second day of work was shorter, and by the end, my new roof was finished. Throughout the whole project, Tracy made sure the job site stayed clean—especially picking up all the nails and debris from the old roof. They truly respected my property and took safety seriously. Overall, they delivered everything as promised, kept me informed, finished on time, and offered great value. What could have been a stressful project turned out to be a smooth and positive experience.
reviews.author: kerri hogan

reviews.text: We had some leaks showing up on our living room ceiling, so we called a local roofing company in Carrollton to come inspect our roof and give us an estimate. That same afternoon, Brayden from their team arrived. I pointed out the leak spots inside, and he went right up on our steep roof for a thorough inspection. After checking everything, Brayden explained that our roof was actually in good shape. He couldn’t find any roofing problems, but noticed that our chimney hadn’t been wrapped properly before the siding was installed. He also pointed out that the bark siding was drying out and should be replaced. Brayden took the time to explain exactly how the water was getting in and why it showed up at the lowest point of the ceiling. He was extremely professional, friendly, and clearly knew his stuff. Best of all, he didn’t charge us for the visit. We brought in a trusted carpenter who agreed with Brayden’s assessment, gave us a fair estimate, and handled the repairs. If we ever need roof work done in the future, we’ll definitely call this company again. We really appreciate their honesty and the way they put customers first.
reviews.author: Maurice Macdonald

reviews.text: brayden and his crew did a fantastic job on our roofing project. brayden was really professional, knew his stuff, and communicated clearly. i work in construction management, so i can honestly say this roofing company delivers quality workmanship. our home in carrollton is pretty old, but they replaced the whole roof in just four days, taking care of shingle removal, facia boards, gutters, vents, and putting on new asphalt shingles. we had some dry rot damage on the roof, and brayden let me know about it right away, explained everything, and gave us a fair price for the extra repairs. we are very happy with how our roof turned out!
reviews.author: Emery Blake

reviews.text: We recently had our roof re-shingled and are extremely pleased with the work done. Brayden, the manager, is an incredibly knowledgeable, empathetic, pleasant, dependable, and honest individual who made the process of getting my roof and fascia replaced a breeze. His team completed the roof in one day and the fascia on another. Every member of the team showed great respect and ensured that the site was thoroughly cleaned up. Brayden is clearly passionate about his work and always strives to ensure customer satisfaction. My roof looks stunning, and I couldn't be happier. In conclusion, Rivera & Sons Roofers LLC are highly skilled professionals providing top-grade materials and installation at an unbeatable price. I wouldn't hesitate to recommend them to family and anyone else in need of roofing services. Thank you once again!
reviews.author: Carlos Friedman

reviews.text: We recently had our trio of new roofs installed and my spouse and I are beyond pleased with the outcome. Tracy and her team delivered an outstanding and highly professional service, demonstrating kindness and responsiveness to our needs and worries. A special thanks to Brayden, who evaluated all three roofs, clarified the job details and warranties on the shingles, and provided answers to all our queries. The cost was fair and reasonable. The entire project was executed in a single day and the waste was swiftly removed the following morning. We also appreciate the site supervisor and the individual who repaired the siding and capping. Our gratitude also extends to the diligent office staff who promptly answered our emails and phone calls, kept us updated, and promptly emailed our receipt. We're very satisfied customers.
reviews.author: Sophie Hardin

reviews.text: I had an amazing experience with Brayden after a hail storm damaged my roof. Following the storm, I was approached by several contractors for roof repairs. At first, I was hesitant to trust someone knocking on my door, but Brayden was very open and honest about the insurance payments and what I would need to pay out of pocket. He provided a quote and gathered all the necessary information without any pressure on me. Once we figured out the insurance details, the work began smoothly. The job was completed in just a couple of days, and I was pleased to see that the work area was left clean afterward. It was particularly impressive considering Brayden was busy with his wedding coming up soon. I received the exact payments from the insurance company and paid the difference, which matched the initial quote perfectly. Throughout the whole process, my questions were answered clearly and honestly. I would definitely recommend Brayden to my friends and family for any roofing needs. It was a great experience during what could have been a stressful home repair!
reviews.author: Luca S

reviews.text: I began utilizing Rivera & Sons Roofers LLC for my roofing needs after a friend in Carrollton bought a house which had been roofed by them. Despite the house having a few leaks and being out of warranty, they repaired it free of charge. Tracy and Brayden installed my roof a few years before the hurricanes and only a few ridge shingles were lost. More than 15 years later, I encountered a leak which they fixed for a small fee. While they were on site, they spotted several potential issues and promptly addressed them. When the time comes for a new roof, my first choice will be Rivera & Sons Roofers LLC.
reviews.author: Brandy Salas

reviews.text: Tracy, Brayden and the crew were simply fantastic. Unlike several other firms I was dealing with, they promptly answered or returned phone calls. Their team of 'Roofing Warriors' finished the roof in a single day. Clean-up was a continuous process from beginning to end. The final cleanup was extremely thorough and they were out of sight by 5:30. The new roof is stunning - the skylights they updated look fantastic and the fresh rain gutters are a godsend! The following day, Brayden conducted a secondary inspection and ensured a top-quality job and clean-up by walking around the property. I'm immensely impressed with their work, the team, and the personal attention given by all involved. They are top-notch in my book. I will highly recommend Rivera & Sons Roofers LLC to my friends and family!
reviews.author: Wendy Stephenson

reviews.text: I want to express my immense gratitude to Rivera & Sons Roofers LLC. Their exceptional services have helped my family in ways beyond words. After a rainstorm, my roof was leaking in many spots, to the point where the ceiling in one of the rooms collapsed. As our home is a manufactured one, and due to its age, there's no home owners insurance. This has been a financial and emotional struggle for me as a single mother of a 15-year-old son, especially after the loss of my daughter. I was at a loss and clueless about what to do, until Rivera & Sons Roofers LLC stepped in. I had been quoted outrageous prices by other roofers, but Rivera & Sons Roofers LLC came to our aid. Their team, including Brayden and Tracy, arrived on a Wednesday morning and worked tirelessly until the job was done by evening. They were professional, efficient, and courteous. I wholeheartedly recommend them for their swift and outstanding work. Moreover, they also offer financing options, which is a huge relief. I can't thank them enough for all the help they've extended to us in our hour of need. My son and I will always be grateful to them.
reviews.author: Jimmy Miranda

reviews.text: Brayden made the entire roof replacement process smooth and hassle-free by establishing excellent communication with my realtor. I was quite impressed with the fact that Brayden kept his word, doing exactly what he promised. His exceptional communication skills ensured that my realtor was informed at every stage of the project. The quality of work was excellent, with 30-year shingles used for the job. I would highly recommend Rivera & Sons Roofers LLC for anyone in need of a roof replacement. Not only was the quality of work outstanding, but the pricing was also very competitive. A big thank you to Brayden and his team for their professional work.
reviews.author: Rodney Carroll

reviews.text: Brayden from Rivera & Sons Roofers LLC was amazing to collaborate with! He went the extra mile from the beginning, coordinating with the insurance company to get the roof, gutters, and window screens replaced. He also worked closely with the crew to ensure the protection of my plants and trees around the house. The quality of work on the roof was outstanding and was finished within the promised timeline of a single day. After completion, the worksite was cleaned thoroughly. I'm pretty sure I now have the best looking roof in my vicinity! Brayden's communication skills throughout the entire process were incredibly impressive. He kept me up-to-date with all the necessary information and was quick to call or respond to texts. His exceptional customer service is reminiscent of a time when customer satisfaction was a top priority. Without a second thought, I would highly recommend Brayden and his team.
reviews.author: Jeffrey15 C

reviews.text: Rivera & Sons Roofers LLC is genuinely top-notch! I was in need of a new roofing and gutter system. Like any diligent homeowner, I sought and received three quotations prior to meeting Brayden, the head of the company. The company was highly recommended by my daughter's townhouse complex in Carrollton, who had hired them based on meticulous comparisons. Brayden booked my appointment, arrived punctually, and dedicated a good portion of an hour elucidating the advantages and distinct features of the roofing materials and gutters. No other service provider took such lengths to clarify these differences! Moreover, only Brayden took the initiative to follow up! There was no demand for a down payment, and I was provided with a detailed contract outlining every step along with the associated costs. Within a fortnight, they scheduled us as per my convenience and were spot on with the timing! The team of five, including Tracy, swiftly set up all necessary covers and got to work on a particularly hot day in Carrollton. They utilized an equipter and a dumpster for the old roof disposal. The team was outstanding, managing to finish the job in just a day! The roof looked splendid! They tidied up after themselves so well; it was as if nothing had ever happened! A week later, they returned to install our 6' seamless gutters, rounding off the look perfectly. I would award this company a full 10 stars if possible! My neighbors have been so impressed by their work that they're planning on hiring them too! They have certainly gone above and beyond our expectations!
reviews.author: Chad Rowe

reviews.text: I would strongly endorse this roofing company based on our personal experience. Our roof replacement took place a couple of years ago. Brayden visited our Carrollton home to inspect our roof, providing a detailed explanation and photos of the damage. He then presented us with various options, including a comprehensive overview of the different products, warranties, and prices. We appreciated not feeling rushed into making a significant decision. We took our time, obtaining quotes from two other roofing companies. However, we selected this company based on their product quality and warranty value. When it came to the actual service, the crew was punctual and completed the roofing job within a day. The clean-up afterwards was also commendable. Tracy checked in during the work progress, followed up the next day with final inspections, took photos, and handled the payment process. We promptly received our warranty via email. Any queries my spouse and I had during this process were addressed swiftly and professionally. The best part? No more leaks and numerous compliments on our new roof! Given our positive experience, I requested Tracy to arrange a call from their flooring division, and as expected, I received a call promptly and now have an appointment scheduled. They were as prompt and courteous as ever!
reviews.author: Derek Rubio

reviews.text: My wood shake roof in Carrollton is getting on in years, having served me for 16 years. Some of the shake had started to curl and I discovered two small holes in the roof. I was unsure whether my roof required maintenance or a complete replacement. I reached out to four roofers for their professional opinion - two of them suggested it wasn't worth fixing and quoted a hefty 18K for a roof replacement. However, Rivera & Sons Roofers LLC and another company reassured me that my roof was still in good condition and just needed some maintenance. I decided to go with Rivera & Sons Roofers LLC, mainly because Brayden was very prompt in his response and his suggested maintenance wasn't destructive. He recommended sliding in new shake under the curled up ones. The final bill came to a reasonable $400. A year on, after enduring a particularly heavy rainstorm, I inspected the attic and was delighted to find no leaks.
reviews.author: Kendra Cummings

reviews.text: Brayden did a phenomenal job on my roofing project from inception to completion. I decided to get a new roof and gutters for my house and garage. Brayden and his team arrived punctually and completed the task within four days. Their post-work cleanup was faultless. They consistently tidied up at the end of each day. Brayden was always ready to answer any queries or concerns I had, even responding promptly to texts. His professionalism put me at ease in choosing Rivera & Sons Roofers LLC. The pricing was reasonable and the end result was stunning, giving my house a remarkable makeover. I appreciate your effort, Brayden. I'm excited for our future collaborations, especially when I decide to work on the siding of my house next.
reviews.author: Everett Flynn

reviews.text: My mother-in-law had an old leak in a valley on her barrel tile roof, so we reached out to Rivera & Sons Roofers LLC. Brayden heads up the repair team and built a fantastic rapport with my mother-in-law. He organized an estimate, which was followed by a clear proposal and pricing. When they started the work, they discovered a more significant problem than expected - termites. Despite this, the team did an amazing job resolving all issues at the initially quoted price! They were punctual, tidy, and efficient. I would highly recommend them for all roofing repairs! Brayden is an excellent point of contact for all repair related queries.
reviews.author: C Kerr

reviews.text: Our roof replacement journey with Rivera & Sons Roofers LLC was spectacular! I've never witnessed a team of roofers as efficient and punctual as Tracy and Brayden. They demonstrated immense knowledge, organization, and focus. No time was wasted, they didn't unnecessarily drag out the job, nor did they reach any point in the work where they were confused. From the beginning to the end, it was a top-notch service! Brayden led the team and I'm certain they made him proud! Many thanks once again for an outstanding experience in Carrollton!
reviews.author: Logan Livingston

reviews.text: rivera & sons roofers llc is the best roofing company i've ever worked with on my home. as a single female homeowner, i've faced many challenges finding reliable, fairly priced contractors who are respectful and truly skilled in their craft. this team exceeded my expectations in every way. their warm and friendly atmosphere made me feel like i was part of a family. my carpenter, who was working on other projects at my home, observed the roofing work from start to finish. he remarked on their exceptional craftsmanship and said it was the best he had ever seen. he specifically noted the attention to detail, like the flashing, and mentioned how they went above and beyond to ensure a top-notch job. since i’m not an expert in roofing, i took it as a huge compliment for another contractor to speak so highly of their work. brayden, one of the team members, was an excellent communicator and always kept me informed about the details and work schedule. the entire crew worked diligently from arrival to completion. in the end, my roof looks stunning, and i feel so happy coming home every day. choosing metal has made a remarkable difference, and i have full confidence in the quality of the work performed. i will definitely hire them again when i renovate my barn!
reviews.author: Jeremy7 P

reviews.text: When a tree fell on our property in Carrollton, Rivera & Sons Roofers LLC provided exceptional service! Brayden was incredibly helpful, guiding us through the home insurance paperwork and thoroughly explaining the process. Collaborating with Tracy was a fantastic experience, and their team did a top-notch job! I would undoubtedly recommend them for any roofing needs you may have.
reviews.author: Piper R

reviews.text: i’d like to share my experience with rivera & sons roofers llc. i attended a home and garden show to get roofing estimates and thought it would be best to set up appointments in advance rather than contacting multiple companies. i scheduled eight appointments and encountered a mix of aggressive sales tactics. however, one representative truly stood out—tracy from rivera & sons roofers llc. her friendly demeanor and knowledgeable presentation of the roofing products impressed me. tracy patiently answered all my questions, including my curiosity about why they didn’t need to inspect my attic like others had suggested. she explained, “if there are any issues, we’ll discover them when we handle the installation, and you’ll see everything for yourself.” after receiving a few more estimates, i felt confident moving forward with rivera & sons. once i signed my estimate online, tracy called me to confirm, and i had already chosen my shingle color. the next day, i was informed that a dumpster and shingles would arrive. the team at rivera & sons is incredibly prompt and efficient. i even received a confirmation call from the owner, who shared that the crew would be there the following day. despite some rain on the drop-off day, the team arrived as planned. brayden, the project manager, organized everything, and the crew worked diligently. my new roof looks fantastic! they discovered some rot, but it was taken care of with the three free boards they provided. the crew left the area spotless as if they had never been there! rivera & sons roofers llc has a fantastic team and a top-notch roofing service.
reviews.author: Mindy P

reviews.text: Brayden and his team did an excellent job re-roofing our 32'x24' cabin and 38x28' 2-story garage (with dormers) in Carrollton. The quote from Rivera & Sons Roofers LLC was fair and competitive when stacked against two other local estimates. The scheduling process was swift, and the work was finished in a timely manner. Brayden was quick to respond to a follow-up ensuring all the work was finished and the area was cleaned up. The team went the extra mile by replacing a gutter run that had only minor dents from a ladder. we could have easily overlooked the minor issue as it wasn't causing any leaks or pulling away from the roofline. However, Brayden insisted on the replacement at his own expense. If i had another roofing project, he would be my first and only choice.
reviews.author: Tucker Molina

reviews.text: The team from Rivera & Sons Roofers LLC were fantastic! The costs were sensible and within budget. Tracy and Brayden responded to my initial inquiry immediately, provided a quote in no time, and maintained excellent communication throughout. They completed the roofing project in Carrollton promptly and now my roof looks absolutely great! A+ indeed. Thanks once more!
reviews.author: Kristy Pearson

reviews.text: I cannot recommend Brayden and Tracy enough! Our home in Carrollton was severely damaged due to a storm and Brayden was the only one among many roofers who took the time to come out and inspect our roof. During his visit, he opted to secure a few areas with a tarp free of charge, as rain was forecasted for the following week and he didn't want to leave our home exposed. This is the level of customer care you desire when hiring someone to work on your roof. The team from Rivera & Sons Roofers LLC did a superb job and left no mess behind! Brayden also coordinated the installation of siding and gutters, and they all did an exceptional job. He even suggested a few companies for interior work! They were both understanding and flexible when it came to delays in billing due to the insurance process. I can't express enough gratitude for their commitment. Support local businesses, and give Rivera & Sons Roofers LLC a call!
reviews.author: Monique Reid

reviews.text: our insurance folks sent us a note saying we needed to fix our roof, and should consider replacing it (it's only 7 years old). tracy took a look at our roof and fixed a single shingle. he gave us a letter outlining the work done which we passed on to our insurance company. they were happy with the repair and agreed with tracy's suggestion that the roof is still in good shape and doesn't need replacing. tracy was really professional and polite. would definitely recommend Rivera & Sons Roofers LLC. five stars just don't do them justice!
reviews.author: Heidi Bell

reviews.text: I'm extremely satisfied with the outstanding service I received from this roofing company! I required a roof repair due to a branch puncturing a hole, and Tracy was there on a weekend to provide a temporary solution before a snowstorm hit. I believe Tracy went the extra mile to help me out. In addition, they took care of removing a chimney from a fireplace that was never going to be used. The team, led by Brayden, executed the job wonderfully! I was even able to close my permit. I'm very happy with their work and look forward to hiring them again when it's time for a roof replacement later.
reviews.author: Donna Archer

reviews.text: i'm really glad someone pointed us in the direction of this company. Rivera & Sons Roofers LLC has been a joy to work with. Their communication is top-notch, they're easy to interact with, and their pricing is fair. They do what they say they're going to do, and they arrive promptly when they say they will. But the best part is the quality of the roofing work. I would confidently recommend them to anyone. Give Brayden and Tracy a call. You'll be happy you did.
reviews.author: Charlotte27 D

reviews.text: Tracy and Brayden at Rivera & Sons Roofers LLC are top-notch professionals! Their efficiency and speed are commendable. The team descended upon our home in Carrollton and completed an entire roof replacement in just 2 days. The end result was a beautiful new roof that exceeded our expectations. Not only that, but they also left our yard even cleaner than it was before they arrived, truly embodying the values my grandpa Hudson instilled in me.
reviews.author: Casey Haas

reviews.text: I decided to hold off on penning my review until after a good downpour. About a year prior, I got an estimate for a flat roof replacement but only decided to go ahead with it now. When I reconnected with Brayden, he provided me with an updated quote and assured me the new roof would be ready before the Thanksgiving holiday. I was skeptical, seeing as it was only a month away and permits still needed to be obtained. However, Brayden wasn't just blowing hot air; the permits came through within a week and the roof was up the following week. Essentially, from the moment I got in touch to sign the contract, it was only two weeks until my new roof was in place. I was pretty taken aback by the speed of it all! On the first day of installation, the team arrived bright and early as promised. Tracy seemed to be leading the team and was incredibly friendly and accommodating. But, I'm not one to take things at face value, I needed to see results. They worked diligently throughout the day, and by the second day, they were only applying the finishing touches. The crew told me they'd be back at 7:30 am the next day. They showed up, but only to collect some tools and let me know they'd return around noon. I was a bit perplexed, so I gave Brayden a call. He explained they had accidentally cracked the last row of tiles on the flat roof and were trying to source the same ones. I get that they have other jobs to juggle and need to organize their schedule efficiently. And hey, mishaps happen, but I was a bit miffed they hadn't kept me in the loop from the start. After all, I had extra tiles in my shed they could have used to get a head start that day. Despite this minor hiccup, Tracy was very accommodating and ensured the site was cleaned up at the end of each day. After experiencing some heavy rain recently, I was pleased to see no sign of any leaks. In conclusion, this roofer provides reliable services at a fair price. My roof was completed in one and a half days, and the inspection was passed the following day. Brayden was patient and professional throughout the process. I'm not the easiest customer to please, but he always followed through on his promises. Thanks, Brayden, for a job well done on my two flat roofs.
reviews.author: Josephine Dougherty

reviews.text: i needed some shingle repairs on a rented property in Carrollton and Rivera & Sons Roofers LLC gave me a reasonable estimate and finished the job quickly. if my house or other rental properties need more roofing repairs, i won't think twice about contacting them again. They are such an incredible roofing team to collaborate with! tracy and Brayden were especially supportive.
reviews.author: Tabitha Costa

reviews.text: Last year, I found myself in need of a timely roof replacement due to my home insurance conditions. A local roofing company was incredibly accommodating, adjusting their packed schedule to ensure my roof replacement was finished before my insurance lapsed. The team, including Tracy and Brayden, showed utmost respect for my daily routines, often relocating their tools and supplies to allow me easy access to my garage. They ensured the site was tidy at the end of each day and after the project's completion. The speed and efficiency with which the job was completed were truly commendable. My main point of contact, Brayden, was superb. He promptly and adequately addressed my numerous queries, making him a pleasure to work with on this project. I recently observed what seemed to be an issue with my garage ceiling. Having had leaks previously, I feared new damage. Upon calling Brayden, he arrived the same day to assess the situation. Using photos taken before the roof replacement, he confirmed that the roof replacement hadn't caused the perceived change. Instead, he identified a different potential cause. Brayden and the team proceeded to clean and replace the attic ventilation covers, even in the rain. This helped confirm that the minor difference in the garage ceiling was due to a ventilation issue rather than a roof leak. This positive experience has led me to recommend this roofing company to my friends, and I will continue to sing their praises when the opportunity arises.
reviews.author: Carrie N

reviews.text: Tracy and Brayden delivered a comprehensive roof removal service, executed promptly. We recently had a substantial rainstorm in Carrollton, and the roof performed flawlessly. There were some necessary carpentry and decking repairs, which were skillfully managed. My spouse and I had originally installed our building's roof twenty years ago, and we're happy with the high-quality service we've received this time. The location was left immaculately clean after the work. The final expense was within $300 of the preliminary quote, a minor variance due to the carpentry repairs, including labor and materials. We're thrilled we selected this roofer for our roofing requirements.
reviews.author: Dana Andrews

reviews.text: The roof repair service in Carrollton is truly exceptional! They performed an outstanding job in cleaning my roof and applying Roof-a-Cide. Booking their services was a breeze and they were swift to fit me into their schedule. In the course of the project, a roof tile was accidentally damaged. Though I might have missed it, and they could have easily brushed it off or even tried to bill me extra for the repair, they opted to bring it to my attention and rectified it without any additional charges. Their work was not only carried out to perfection, but they also treated me with the utmost respect. Brayden and Tracy's team have won over a lifelong customer.
reviews.author: Heidi Hatfield

reviews.text: I engaged Rivera & Sons Roofers LLC for a chimney fix and comprehensive roof servicing in Carrollton. The quality of their work was genuinely impressive. Brayden, the proprietor, surpassed the standards outlined in the contract and accomplished additional tasks without imposing any extra fees. Their pricing was also quite reasonable. I will certainly return to them for any forthcoming roofing requirements.
reviews.author: Allison Hutchinson

reviews.text: I was utterly satisfied with the roofer's service; their professionalism was truly praiseworthy. Tracy made sure to manage the interactions with the insurance company and worked together seamlessly with me. The work was carried out promptly and a thorough inspection around my entire house in Carrollton showed no debris; they cleaned up immaculately. You'll find no reason for dissatisfaction.
reviews.author: Kaleb Brewer

reviews.text: the roofing project for this assisted living facility involved both asphalt shingle and single ply membrane roof replacement. it was a sizeable and intricate project that needed coordination with other building trades. tracy and brayden came up with a solid project plan and adhered to it. they managed to keep a safe, clean space throughout the entire renovation, which was crucial since the facility was completely occupied during the work. they made sure that the owner's construction team was always kept in the loop. the project was always properly staffed, finished on time and within budget. great job, team!
reviews.author: Dana Mcgrath

reviews.text: i had been attempting to reach my insurance firm for a year regarding the replacement and assistance with the process of getting them to fund and replace shingles, gutters, storm door, and windows. not only did brayden inform me that i could still get them to pay almost a year later, but he also handled all the communication, photo exchange, and negotiation with the insurance. then, rivera & sons roofers llc completed the work in a swift and sensible timeframe, even amidst a pandemic. all tasks were done and completed professionally in carrollton, the result looks fantastic and they took care of all the cleaning post-work. would suggest to anyone in need of roofing services.
reviews.author: Anna West

reviews.text: Brayden was absolutely top-notch. his communication skills were fantastic, something i really appreciate, and his responsiveness was off the charts. He climbed up onto the roof to check its state, snapped some photos, and clearly explained his findings as well as proposed solutions. He came back the next day to Carrollton and finished the job. His customer service was nothing short of excellent.
reviews.author: S Davila

reviews.text: the rooftop service they provide is exceptional! i requested their service online, and their clear signage guided me to the designated parking areas in carrollton. once parked, it was straightforward to notify brayden via their website that i had arrived. i only had to wait for 5-7 minutes before tracy brought out the necessary roofing materials! their service was top-notch!
reviews.author: A Meyer
